about.bio: I hold a Master's degree in Information Security for Restricted-Access Environments, with a cryptography-focused thesis — the itch for provable, airtight systems started there and never really left. I'm drawn to hard engineering problems: the kind where a database is spiking, a queue is backing up, or one message quietly breaks a pipeline, and the fix means tracing the system until the "why" actually clicks. I've spent time restructuring 1.5TB of raw data into something a model could actually learn from, and a year and a half as the de facto tier-4 escalation on a production system — closing it out with zero open tickets. I like problems that fight back a little.
about.hobbies: Outside of work I'm usually outdoors — hiking, biking, skiing, and chasing the right light for wildlife photography.
